ruleDefinitions.name: Invoke-Obfuscation CLIP+ Launcher
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects Obfuscated use of Clip.exe to execute PowerShell

sequences.query: ((process_command_line = RGX(".*cmd.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\&\\&.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*clipboard\\]\\:\\:.*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-f.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/c.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\/r.*")))
